label: b34: zigzag shaping 0.5 (potential-based, window 8), hist8 at 100M, seed 3 of 8
notes: Batch b34: zigzag shaping on b27's hist8 config, verbatim, at 100M (plans/zigzag-shaping.md). Two cells of four seeds: zz = SNEK_ZIGZAG_SHAPING 0.5, a potential-based term Phi = -(reversal pairs among the last 8 moves the body shows, the observation history depth), F = c*(gamma*Phi(s') - Phi(s)); rp = SNEK_REVERSAL_PENALTY 0.5, subtracted on every step whose move is a left straight after a right or the converse, terminal steps included. A reversal is adjacent moves only; a U-turn (the same turn twice) is not one. Control: b27's hist8 cell (b27q-x), the same config at 100M with anneal fraction 0.5 (gamma 0.99->0.999, lambda 0.95->0.999, entropy 0.01->0.001 final at 50M). Measured before queueing: b32g @62423040 reverses on 1.71% of steps (0.178 per meal, 16.9 per episode), 4% below 50% fill and ~0 above 60%. Prediction (agent, 2026-09-16): zz level with hist8 on density and the 30k top, reversal rate by fill within 1 pp of the champion's (the invariance holds, PPO takes nothing from the hint, as b21 found for chase-safe); rp cuts the early-board reversal rate by more than half and leaves the endgame's ~0, density within noise of hist8. A density or 30k gain in rp would falsify findings.md's 'zigzagging is not the mechanism'; a density loss in rp would say the early zigzags are load-bearing. Pinned to the desktop, one wave.
